one_line: Open-source Firebase alternative: Postgres database with REST (PostgREST) and GraphQL APIs, auth, storage and realtime.
auth_notes: Project URL + anon/publishable key (client) or service_role key (admin) passed as apikey header; keys are JWTs; OAuth2 available for auth providers via Supabase Auth
self_serve_notes: Free tier; create a project in dashboard and get URL + keys instantly; self-serve, no approval

api_surface.breadth_estimate: PostgREST auto-generated REST per table plus GraphQL (pg_graphql), RPC, Storage, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime; SDKs for JS/Python/etc
api_surface.webhook_note: Database webhooks (via pg_net), Edge Function triggers, and Realtime subscription streams

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP server confirmed; multiple community MCP servers exist (knowledge); fetched text confirms REST (PostgREST) + JWT keys and official JS client

evidence.note: fetched text confirms supabase-js client, Data API/PostgREST, JWT keys, RLS and RPC

agent_notes: Instant keys on project creation; REST via PostgREST is straightforward to target.
